CITY OF COSTA MESA
  REGULAR CITY COUNCIL AND HOUSING AUTHORITY*
  Agenda

Wednesday, October 15, 2025  5:30 PM  Norma Hertzog Community Center
  1845 Park Ave.
  SPECIAL MEETING - HOMELESS SOLUTIONS TOWNHALL MEETING

A City Council Town Hall will take place on Oct. 15, 2025, from 5:30 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. at the
Norma Hertzog Community Center to discuss how the City is tackling homelessness and the
issues surrounding it. The Town Hall will feature an open house from 5:30 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.
with staff and community service partners including Mercy House, Bracken’s Kitchen,
Lighthouse Church, Trellis, Project Hope Alliance and SOS, who will be available to share
information and answer questions regarding services such as outreach, shelter, behavioral
health, and housing. City staff work closely with these community partners to form the
Network for Homeless Solutions.

The event will be filmed and available on the City website for public viewing.
